name: interrupt-mask-disable
intent: Prevent maskable interrupt delivery to the current CPU until re-enabled.
postconditions: maskable interrupt delivery is disabled for the current CPU
invariants: pending interrupt state is not discarded

name: address-space-activate
intent: Make a supplied address space the active translation context for the current CPU.
postconditions: subsequent translations derive from the supplied address space
stale translations cannot preserve access forbidden by current mappings after required synchronization

name: translation-sync
intent: Make translation visibility satisfy the requested synchronization scope.
preconditions: affected mapping state has been published as required
postconditions: translations in scope reflect the current mapping state according to the contract
invariants: stale translations cannot bypass current permissions

name: monotonic-time-read
intent: Return time from a monotonic boot-local clock domain.
postconditions: returned value is greater than or equal to prior values in the same boot domain
invariants: clock does not move backward within its defined domain

name: userspace-enter
intent: Begin execution of a supplied user context at user privilege.
preconditions: active address space permits the requested entry and stack
postconditions: execution begins with user privilege and requested portable context state
